<style>

/* Hide the empty page title generated by Wowchemy */
.article-header,
.page-header {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Match the width of the rest of the website */
main .container,
main .universal-wrapper {
  width: calc(100% - 60px) !important;
  max-width: 1500px !important;
  margin-left: auto !important;
  margin-right: auto !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* Contact section */
.contact-page {
  max-width: 700px;
  margin: 20px 0 60px;
}

/* Page title */
.contact-title {
  margin: 0 0 40px;
  color: #2f4858;
  font-size: 30px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

/* Name */
.contact-name {
  margin: 0 0 2px;
  color: #2f4858;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

/* Email */
.contact-email {
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.contact-email a {
  color: #4f9f90;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.contact-email a:hover {
  color: #397f73;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Address */
.contact-address {
  margin: 0;
  color: #3f474c;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  font-style: normal;
}

/* Mobile */
@media screen and (max-width:768px){

  main .container,
  main .universal-wrapper{
    width:calc(100% - 30px)!important;
  }

  .contact-title{
    font-size:27px;
    margin-bottom:34px;
  }

  .contact-name{
    font-size:22px;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }

  .contact-email{
    margin-bottom:18px;
    font-size:16px;
  }

  .contact-address{
    font-size:15px;
  }

}

</style>
